instruction: Audit EVERY required output against subtasks and actual source content. Check extraction source includes all necessary operands, including operands across table and text; types alone are insufficient. Return only compact schema: status PASS/FAIL, error_code, issue node_refs, evidence <=160 characters, replan. Do not retell DAG. PASS requires error_code NONE and replan false. This is heuristic, not correctness proof.
candidate_specific: node_refs enum and graph content are built from candidate, actual hashes logged before each request
unaccepted_candidate_rule: No repair/fallback; no review; no substitute request
